problemStatement.formal: For N : PolygonalNoodle n, N.expectedCrossings d = 2 * N.totalLength / (pi * d)
problemStatement.plain: Buffons Noodle: expected crossings of a polygonal path with parallel line grid equals 2L/(pi*d), depending only on total length.

currentState.focus: Proved polygonal noodle theorem; smooth curve case documented as open
currentState.nextAction: Extend to smooth curves using Mathlib arc length theory

knowledge.progressSummary: PROGRESS: Buffons Noodle theorem for polygonal paths formally proved. E[crossings] = 2L/(pi*d) depends only on total length via linearity of expectation. Shape independence theorem proved. Smooth curve generalization documented as requiring arc length theory.
